note: Confidences are model confidences, not versions. Laya is uncalibrated; both are second opinions.

state.decision: Safety and clarity decisions for the GrapiX Playout operator screen, raised by a UX review of the wireframes.
state.product: Playout is the live operator application of a broadcast graphics system. It has a Preview player (play, pause, stop, loop) that is separate from air, an on-air monitor, a sequence of takes, and a virtual output: a local window that shows the real engine render of a take sent to it, for checking before going live. The virtual output is independent of the live output (DeckLink, NDI): both can be active at once, and neither blocks the other. Only Playout may take, continue or clear Program.
state.findings_from_review: The Preview block contains a button 'Take this live' beside Play and Pause, while the page's own rule says only the controls under the on-air monitor act on air. In the 'Try it' console the primary button sends a live TAKE and the secondary sends to preview only. The on-air row in the sequence is visually quieter than the cued row, TAKE OUT and CLEAR are 4 px apart and not armed, and the accent orange for selection and the on-air orange differ by only a few percent. A Take ID is meant to be typed by the operator and be unique in the show, but the wireframe auto-numbers new takes.
state.constraints: Operators work under time pressure. A mistaken live take cannot be undone. The Editor has no live controls.

take_button.instructions: Where should the action that puts a take live be placed?

criteria.A: One TAKE control only, in the transport area under the on-air monitor; nothing in the Preview block can act on air.
criteria.B: Keep a 'Take this live' button inside the Preview block as a shortcut as well.

armed_live_send.instructions: In the console that sends a command by Take ID, which should be the default action?

criteria.A: Default to the safe action (cue to preview or the local virtual output); sending live needs a separate, clearly marked and armed control.
criteria.B: Default to sending live; preview-only is the secondary button.

virtual_output_model.instructions: How should the local checking facilities be organised?

criteria.A: One local monitor: the virtual output window shows the real engine render of a checked take and carries play, pause and stop. No separate Preview.
criteria.B: Two: a quick in-app Preview player plus a separate virtual output window that can sit on another monitor and be captured.

onair_prominence.instructions: Should the on-air row use the on-air colour and be the most prominent row, with selection shown neutrally so it cannot be confused with on air?

criteria.true: Yes: on air is the loudest state; selection is neutral.
criteria.false: No: selection keeps the accent colour and on air stays quiet.

arm_destructive.instructions: Should TAKE OUT and CLEAR be spatially separated from CONTINUE and HOLD and need an arm or confirm step?

criteria.false: No: keep them adjacent and single-press for speed.

lock_onair_edits.instructions: Should the Take ID and name of a take that is currently on air be locked against editing?

criteria.true: Yes: lock them while on air.
criteria.false: No: allow editing at any time.

suggest_take_id.instructions: When a scene is added to the sequence, should the next free number be suggested as its Take ID, still editable by hand and still required to be unique?

criteria.true: Yes: suggest the next free number; the operator can overwrite it.
criteria.false: No: leave the Take ID empty until typed.

reading.take_button: Jev A (1.00); Laya A (0.60). Agree. One TAKE only, under the on-air monitor (review U-01).
reading.armed_live_send: Jev A (1.00); Laya B (0.73). Disagree. Decided A by hand: the stated constraint is that a mistaken live take cannot be undone (review U-02).
reading.virtual_output_model: Jev B (0.84); Laya B (0.90). Agree on two (quick Preview plus a separate virtual output window). The owner's wording suggests the purposes overlap, so this goes back to the owner.

reading.arm_destructive: Jev yes 0.86; Laya undecided (0.49). Adopted yes (review U-05).
reading.lock_onair_edits: Jev yes 0.86; Laya yes 0.73. Agree. Adopted.
